## Planning item

Which current-version planning item does this contribute to? It does not have to finish the item. Alternatively, which approved issue authorises this work?

## Completion

Does this finish the planning item? If not, what remains?

## Risk and breakage

What could this change break, including stored data or existing workflows?

## Tests

What tests attest to the changed behaviour? Include the commands run and results.

## Documentation coverage

What documentation obligations were triggered? Which documentation was updated, and which follow-up issues were opened?

## Testing follow-up

Is further coverage needed? Which issues track it?

## Accessibility impact

Does this affect interaction or accessibility? What was considered, and what limitations remain?

## Future concerns

Did this reveal technical debt, architectural concerns, problems, or future work? Which issues track them?
